Define the compound set by starting from molecule_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1422', then join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno to include the parent and all related salts. For this compound set, retrieve activity rows via the FAQ provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records (on molregno) -> docs (on doc_id) -> activities (on record_id) -> assays (on assay_id) -> target_dictionary (on tid). LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to activities where standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by all returned columns. No row limit.
